headline: Accepted disposition of 15 provisional ballots and the limited ballot from the Primary Election.
summary: The Canvassing Authority reviewed the Primary Election provisional ballot process, accepting the disposition of 15 provisional ballots and the limited ballot voted. The board also approved preparing a resolution thanking Town Clerk's Office staff and poll workers.
decisions: Approved the minutes of the meetings held on August 19 and September 9, 2026.

Accepted the limited ballot voted during the Primary Election.
Approved preparing a resolution thanking the Town Clerk's Office, other Town staff, and poll workers for service during the Primary Election, to be presented at an upcoming Town Council meeting.

plain_text:
CANVASSING AUTHORITY  
 
SEPTEMBER 10, 2026 
 
1 
 
At a meeting of the CANVASSING AUTHORITY of the Town of South Kingstown, County of 
Washington, in the State of Rhode Island, held at the Town Hall, in and for said Town on the 
10th day of September 2026 at 2:39 PM. 
PRESENT:  Walter Allen Young, Jr., Chair 
Sarah Louisa Vaccaro, Vice Chair 
Elaine Davis Shanley, Member 
 
 
The meeting of the Canvassing Authority is called to order by Walter Young, Jr., Chair. 
 
UNANIMOUSLY VOTED: to approve the minutes of the meetings held on August 19 and 
September 9, 2026. 
 
Discussion ensues relative to the provisional ballot process. Fifteen total provisional ballots were 
voted, with three approved, three from another municipality, and nine disqualified. 
 
UNANIMOUSLY VOTED: to accept the disposition of 15 provisional ballots voted. 
 
UNANIMOUSLY VOTED: to accept the limited ballot voted during the Primary Election. 
 
The Chair requests that a resolution be prepared thanking the Town Clerk’s Office staff and poll 
workers for their service during the Primary Election, with copies to be provided to the Town 
Council and Town Manager. 
 
UNANIMOUSLY VOTED: that a resolution be prepared in gratitude to the Town Clerk’s Office, 
other Town staff, and poll workers for their service during the Primary Election  to be presented 
during an upcoming Town Council meeting. 
 
The next meeting of the Board of Canvassers will take place on September 21, 2026 at 2:30 PM. 
 
Discussion ensues relative to the final canvass for the General Election due date of October 13, 
2026. 
 
UNANIMOUSLY VOTED: to adjourn at 3:47 PM. 
 
 
Adjourned, 
Emily R. Houle 
Clerk, Canvassing Authority
